holdouts.description: Misleading sender identity with carrier, payer, insured, and represented-client ambiguity.
expected_signals: ROLE_CANDIDATES_AMBIGUOUS critic finding
unknown matter-family option remains available
context-influenced candidates stay source-anchor-only
red_team_notes: A carrier sender must not collapse into represented-client fact.
Practice context must not become observed evidence.

holdouts.description: Carrier, payer, third-party administrator, insured, affiliate, driver, and claimant role matrix that must stay separated for human confirmation.
expected_signals: carrier sender carries insurance_carrier, payer, and instructing_source candidates without becoming prospective represented client
insured entity carries insured and prospective_represented_client alternatives
third-party administrator and affiliate roles remain distinct candidate roles
ROLE_CANDIDATES_AMBIGUOUS dry-run workflow escalation remains review-only
red_team_notes: Carrier, payer, and TPA labels must not silently become client identity.
Insured or affiliate labels must not clear conflicts or authorize matter opening.
Role ambiguity is evidence pressure for human confirmation, not a reason to infer representation.

holdouts.description: Synthetic actual-cost source with no phase or code actuals to force missing-actuals ledger events.
expected_signals: actuals_not_available comparison status
budget_actual_missing_actuals_recorded ledger events
no billing connector read or write
red_team_notes: Missing actuals must not be treated as zero spend.
Intake must not query billing systems directly to fill the gap.

holdouts.description: Synthetic carrier rejection capture bundle with duplicate notices, missing response, unlinked notice, parser failure, and appeal outcome.
expected_signals: duplicate notice collapse
missing response after SLA
appeal financial outcome recorded without appeal submission
red_team_notes: Duplicate portal/email notices must not double-count disputed dollars.
Appeal results are evidence, not permission to mutate guideline profiles.

holdouts.description: Synthetic carrier rejection capture bundle with partial allowances, guideline drift, rate reduction, stale appeal, and denied appeal outcomes.
expected_signals: partial allowances remain source-bound rejection evidence
guideline version drift maps to authority_conflict_override candidate class
stale and denied appeals record financial outcomes without appeal submission
red_team_notes: Partial allowances must not be inflated into full denial exposure.
Stale or denied appeal outcomes must not silently mutate carrier guideline profiles.

holdouts.description: Synthetic budget-driver edge cases for low-intensity, high-intensity, and unknown-driver states.
expected_signals: catastrophic severity produces a higher budget than soft-tissue severity
profile-default intensity effects remain visible but not observed facts
coverage posture remains unknown until human-confirmed
red_team_notes: Driver fixtures can overfit deterministic multipliers if promoted without shadow eval.
Unknown drivers must widen review posture, not invent facts.

holdouts.description: Synthetic labor/employment entity and budget-fact holdout where critical facts are source-bound but budget use remains range-only pending human review.
expected_signals: critical labor/employment budget facts have source-bound candidate support
supervisor and affiliate relationship facts are captured as candidate evidence
important expert/vendor and policy-document facts still require human review
budget readiness is range-only pending human review with no budget submission authority
red_team_notes: Source-bound critical facts are still not human-confirmed facts.
Supervisor, affiliate, and carrier/rate labels must not clear conflicts or authorize matter opening.
Needs-review important facts must keep budget posture broad and review-gated.
